login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Sign in to sync your impact log across devices. Your password never leaves this browser.
login.reauth: Your session has ended. Sign in again — entries on this device are safe and sync will resume.
login.merge: There are {count} entries on this device. If they don't belong to the account you're signing in to, we'll ask what to do with them: add them to the account or erase them from this device.
login.mergeBound: This device is linked to “{login}”. If you sign in to a different account, we'll ask what to do with the entries on this device ({count}): add them to it or erase them.
login.alreadyText: This device syncs with “{login}”. To use another account, sign out in Settings first.
login.cancelled: Sign-in cancelled. Entries on this device are untouched.

secondFactor.title: Verification code
secondFactor.subtitle: Enter the 6 digits from your authenticator app.
secondFactor.lostPhone: Lost access to the app? Recover with your Recovery Key
secondFactor.rememberHint: We’ll always ask for your password, but not for the 2FA code on this device. Don’t check this on shared computers.

register.title: Turn on sync

subtitles.credentials: An account is only needed to sync between devices. Just a username and password — no email, no phone.
subtitles.kit: The only way to get your data back if you forget your password.
subtitles.totp: Two-factor protection is required: even with your password, nobody gets in without your phone.
subtitles.done: Entries are encrypted on this device and reach the server only in encrypted form.

register.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. A phrase of 4–5 random words is best: easy to remember, hard to guess.
register.passwordNote: Your password encrypts the key to your data. We don’t store it and can’t reset it — only your Recovery Key can restore access.
register.localRecords: Entries from this device ({count}) will be encrypted and sent to the new account.
register.alreadyText: This device is linked to “{login}”. To create another account, sign out in Settings first.

doneItems.encrypted: The key to your data was created on this device and never leaves it unencrypted.
doneItems.sync: Sync has started — entries will appear on the server in encrypted form.
doneItems.devices: On another device, just sign in with this username and password.

recoveryKit.label: Recovery Key
recoveryKit.explain: The Recovery Key replaces both your password and your 2FA phone if you lose them. It unlocks your data — keep it as safe as your password, but separately: in a password manager or on paper.
recoveryKit.warning: Without your password and Recovery Key, nobody can recover your data — not even us: we don’t have the key to your entries.
recoveryKit.saved: I’ve saved my Recovery Key in a safe place
recoveryKit.tailHint: A quick check that you saved it: for a key ending …-AB12-CD, type 12CD.
recoveryKit.tailError: Doesn’t match the key — check the last characters
recoveryKit.savedRequired: Confirm that you saved the key

file.title: Recovery Key
instructions: The Recovery Key restores access to your data if you forget your password or lose your 2FA phone.
How to use it: open the “Recover access” page (/recover), enter your username and this key, then set a new password.
Keep it separate from your password: in a password manager or printed in a safe place. Never share it.
Without your password and Recovery Key, nobody can recover your data — not even the impact log team.
If you issue a new key in Settings, this one stops working.

recoveryKit.tailRequired: Enter the last 4 characters of the key

totp.step1: Open your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, 1Password, Bitwarden, Aegis…) and scan the QR code.
totp.step2: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
totp.qrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app

recover.title: Recover with Recovery Key
recover.subtitle: Enter your username and the Recovery Key you saved when signing up. Then set a new password.
recover.keyHint: Starts with ILRK1. Case, spaces and dashes don’t matter.
recover.passwordSubtitle: The key works. Set a new password: the old one stops working, and all sessions and remembered computers are reset.
recover.doneSubtitle: You’re signed in with the new password. Two more steps to make the account safe again.
recover.totpText: Reissue 2FA now: connect the app again, old codes will stop working.
recover.totpDone: 2FA reissued: the new app is now active.
recover.keyText: Recommended: the key you just used may have been left somewhere. A new key replaces the old one immediately.
recover.keyDone: The new Recovery Key is active, the old one no longer works.
recover.expired: Recovery took too long — please start over.
recover.cancelled: Access not restored: the new password was not sent, entries on this device are untouched.

options.merge: Add {count} entry to the account | Add {count} entries to the account
options.wipe: Erase entries from this device and sign in

hints.merge: The entries will be encrypted with the account key and appear on all its devices.
hints.wipe: The entries will be removed from this browser for good. If you need them, cancel and export them first.

kdfChange.title: Password protection settings have changed
kdfChange.text: The server sent different password protection settings for this account than the ones you signed in with on this device before:
kdfChange.weaker: the Argon2id settings are weaker (less memory or fewer passes) — guessing your password from intercepted data gets cheaper
kdfChange.hint: This is expected if you changed your password or recovered access on another device. If you didn't, do not continue: the server may have swapped the settings to make guessing your password easier.
